I did what you told me and it worked, so I was trying to generate a mirtmodel, by generate.mirt_model(), and I saw something that I thought it was interesting:

latent_covariance

(optional) a matrix used to define the population variance-covariance structure between the latent traits. By default the relationship is assumed to be orthogonal standard normal (i.e., an identity matrix)


what it's the matrix dimension? I mean, I want to set that to 100 the latent covariance, how am I supposed to do that?



Thanks again for everything!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: How to change a mirt.model
parts:
The latent_covariance input is just a symmetric matrix reflecting the unstandardized correlation structure. So, it should have as many rows/columns as there are rows in the 'as' input. 

Phil
